== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Admiral Ozzel: the entry “Admiral Ozzel” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 12. Image for [[Admiral Ozzel (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 12 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>6647dd97e6cbba6a8612696c94879457f38054d0</code>, SHA-256 <code>75184505192473c3c641ef77f16811ec4fb5f224b20578ed31cfaade57f659e3</code>.
